new_processes.name: EOL new product rollout handling
new_processes.definition: Communicating new EnronOnline products to schedulers and risk staff, including products that do not bridge to Sitara and must be entered manually.

new_processes.name: Work distribution assignment
new_processes.definition: Announcing which logistics staff handle which counterparties, portfolios or desks.

new_processes.name: Staff vacation and coverage coordination
new_processes.definition: Collecting vacation schedules and announcing who covers each person's duties during absence.

new_processes.name: Monthly transport usage ticket update
new_processes.definition: Refreshing transport usage tickets and rates for the coming month and telling schedulers to update volumes.

new_processes.name: Transport fuel booking question
new_processes.definition: Deciding whether and how to book fuel allocated on a transport contract, including days without flow.

new_processes.name: Desk update file distribution
new_processes.definition: Circulating an updated monthly file to the desk with little accompanying text.

new_processes.name: HPL buy/sell report delivery
new_processes.definition: Producing buy/sell reports from the Unify volume management module and telling colleagues where they are saved.
